svg.title: Motor current and commanded duty cycle during one real gate close
svg.desc: Current peaks at 7.3A as the motor launches at 75% duty, settles near 2.5 to 3A at full speed, then drops to about 1A when the firmware eases the duty to 60% at 9.8s, so the gate reaches the closed limit slowly and is then held by a 1s short-brake. A relay drives 100% the whole way and cuts off at the limit.
svg.text: One real close, recorded by the controller itself
Motor current sampled every 25ms, and the PWM duty cycle the firmware commanded over the same move
7.3A breakaway peak at launch (75% duty, not 100%)
relay: full power, then off at the limit
